```lean
theorem lg_target {K : Type u_2} [Field K] [CharZero K] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic ℚ K] (k : Subfield K) : Algebra.IsAlgebraic (↥k) K := by
  intro x
  intro h
  have h1 : Algebra.IsAlgebraic ℚ x :=
    Algebra.IsAlgebraic.of_subfield (↥k) K h
  exact Algebra.IsAlgebraic.subfield (↥k) K h1
```
